Why Choose Us?

At Handyman Home Services, we offer a wide range of professional handyman services to meet your needs. From carpentry to plumbing, painting to electrical work, we've got you covered. Our team is dedicated to providing quality work at competitive prices.

We are honest, dependable and reliable.

 

And if we say we can do something, we will! We will never over promise or under deliver.

WHO WE ARE

I was raised in Miami but have lived in all parts of Florida.

After graduating High School in Miami, I attended FIU where I received my Bachelor Degree then attended USF for my Graduate Degree in Engineering. Since then, I have been involved in construction for the better part of 29 years.

​

I have been helping family & friends all throughout my life with repair projects and have finally decided to put some of my knowledge to good use and help others.

​

I started Handyman Home Services with the idea to help others solve issues through creative thinking and engineering solutions. We are dedicated to providing top-quality, professional handyman services. I will treat your home no different than I would treat my own house.

​

I am committed to ensuring your satisfaction with every job I do.

We are looking forward to serving you.

HAPPY CUSTOMERS

I recently used Handyman Home Services for a plumbing issue in my home and was extremely impressed with the level of service I received. David was knowledgeable and professional, and the issue was resolved quickly and efficiently. I would highly recommend this company to anyone in need of handyman services.

I had Handyman Home Services install new lighting fixtures in my home and was blown away by the quality of their work. He was friendly and professional, and the finished product looked amazing. I would definitely use this company again for any future handyman needs.
